title: Removes the payment method types parameter from Checkout Sessions
changed: checkout.sessions.create payment_method_types removed: an exact literal ['card'], or with the repository's keep-listed opt-in a literal list that includes card
checkout.sessions.create payment_method_types removed: every other value
reason: removedRequestParameters (request-removals.ts) finds the removed top-level body parameter on the mapped operation; analyzeRepository marks each traced call that still sends it with requestParameter, and migrationReviewReason (migration-review.ts) stops automatic migration, AI and publication with REMOVED_REQUEST_PARAMETER_REVIEW_REASON.
